0.content:
# z/VM and Linux diagnosis

Put z/VM CPU next to OneAgent steal so a slow application can be split into guest wait versus guest work. OneAgent tiles are not filtered by the z/VM LPAR variable.

1.title: z/VM CPU
1.description: zvm.system.cpu.utilization for the selected system and LPAR.

2.title: Guest CPU time
2.description: Cumulative guest CPU counter for the selected guest, system, and LPAR. Apply a rate in the tile if you need cores. DQL timeseries does not take a PromQL rate().

3.title: OneAgent CPU steal
3.description: builtin:host.cpu.steal from OneAgent, percent. Empty until the Linux guest is monitored by OneAgent. This tile does not use the z/VM LPAR variable.

4.title: OneAgent CPU usage
4.description: builtin:host.cpu.usage. Compare with steal. Usage without steal is work inside Linux. This tile does not use the z/VM LPAR variable.
